caption:
In 2010, India made almost no solar power. By 2025 it was third in the world.

2013: into the top 10. 2020: 4th. 2022: past Japan for 3rd.

From 7 TWh in 2015 to 196 TWh in 2025. About 39% more every year, so it doubles every 2.1 years.

Growth that compounds looks slow, then sudden. Work out doubling times free: mba.rimilab.com (link in bio)

Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data.
